meaning:
περι-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:9 4Mac 14:1 * ;]
1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.).
2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; 4Mac, ll. with) : Tit.2:15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
